name: Sweet potato & black bean tacos
steps: Dice the sweet potato and toss with the olive oil, cumin and salt.
Roast at 210C for 25 minutes until soft and caramelised.
Warm the black beans through in a small pan.
Heat the corn tortillas until pliable.
Fill each tortilla with sweet potato and black beans.
Top with sliced avocado and crumbled feta.
